using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Shop.Orders
{
    /// <summary>A comment above a type is not part of it.</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class Cart : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly List<int> _items = [];

        public event EventHandler? Changed;

        public int Count { get; private set; }

        public int Total
        {
            get { return secretTotal(); }
        }

        public int Doubled => secretDoubled();

        public Cart(int capacity) : base()
        {
            secretInit(capacity);
        }

        public void Add<T>(T item) where T : notnull
        {
            secretAdd(item);
            if (secretCheck())
            {
                secretMore();
            }
        }

        public static Cart operator +(Cart a, Cart b) => secretCombine(a, b);

        public int this[int index] => secretIndex(index);

        public void Dispose() { secretDispose(); }

        private enum State { Open, Closed }

        public delegate void Handler(int x);
    }

    public record Line(string Sku, int Quantity);
}
